title: Targeted Deep Regression - Initial Applications in Whole-Body Water-Fat MRI in UK Biobank
abstract: arXiv:2610.35339v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact

translated_title: 靶向深度回归——在英国生物银行全身水脂磁共振成像中的初步应用
translated_abstract: 英国生物银行是一项英国临床研究，除了收集大量医疗数据外，还计划对10万名参与者进行详细的磁共振成像（MRI）检查。图像数据可以通过神经网络的自动化分析进行图像分割或分类等处理，以扩展用于医学研究的图像衍生表型的收集。在本工作中，我们提出、展示并评估了一种基于图像回归的方法学，用于从所收集的颈部至膝盖的水脂MRI扫描中估计数值属性。该方法将ResNet50风格的网络应用于二维多通道拼图，这些拼图代表了MRI扫描中经过靶向选择的、针对特定研究的解剖学子区域。靶向子区域采样是通过图像配准，将手动定义的子区域从参考扫描传播到其他分析过的超过30,000个扫描来实现的。所生成的拼图可以紧凑地（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种靶向深度回归方法，通过图像配准将参考扫描中手动定义的解剖子区域传播到超过3万个MRI扫描，生成二维多通道拼图并用ResNet50风格网络进行回归，以从英国生物银行的全身水脂MRI中估计数值属性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a targeted deep regression methodology that propagates manually defined anatomical sub-regions from a reference scan to over 30,000 MRI scans via image registration, creating 2D multi-channel collages processed by a ResNet50-style network to estimate numerical properties from whole-body water-fat MRI in UK Biobank.
